summaryZh: Simonson Lab 研究人如何响应生活环境，以及这些差异对健康、表现和恢复力的意义。实验室结合基因组学、生理学与分子生物学，涉及不同社区和高海拔居住地区。
researchQuestions: 人如何响应其生活环境，这些响应对健康、表现和恢复力为何重要？

evidence.quote: At the Simonson Lab, we bring together multiple approaches to understand how people respond to the environments they live in—and why this matters for health, performance, and resilience. From local communities to the world’s highest inhabited regions, we unite genomics, physiology, and molecular biology
